title: selective JPEG 2000 source reads

definition.title: selective JPEG 2000 source reads
definition.source_excerpt: The fixture is a 1,024×1,024 grayscale JPEG 2000 codestream, 65,562 bytes, with 256×256 tiles and RPCL progression. A custom OpenJPEG source callback recorded every read/seek and its unique source-byte footprint while decode-area, resolution reduction, and layer limits were applied. Each streaming-source output was compared byte-for-byte against the same decode using the whole codestream as backing. The strong result is spatial/tile selectivity: a requested region need not force all codestream bytes through the source adapter. The negative/unfinished part is equally important: this fixture did not show additional source-byte reduction from resolution or quality-layer restrictions within the same tile region.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Locate one real repeated read/index/validation boundary and its trusted source identity. Separate logical requests from transferred or physical-disk bytes.
definition.minimum_probe: Replay a short owned range/seek trace on a tiny indexed fixture, including its first cold operation, with the same source and authorization. Reuse the existing reader.
definition.initial_screen: Locate one real repeated read/index/validation boundary and its trusted source identity. Separate logical requests from transferred or physical-disk bytes. Replay a short owned range/seek trace on a tiny indexed fixture, including its first cold operation, with the same source and authorization. Reuse the existing reader.
definition.primary_metric: Total bytes and time to correct startup/target, including cold index/identity acquisition; bounded retained bytes.
definition.scope_contract: Source/version identity, requested exact sample/frame, dependency coverage and byte-range accounting.
definition.negative_control: Change the source/version or corrupt an offset/proof and cancel one consumer. No stale or unverified bytes may be published.
definition.stop_boundary: Do not build a generic cache, transport server or index service for a first pass. Preserve a lower-cost component decision if real integration is E3.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Authorized seekable byte provider and a known oracle for sample prerequisites; no guessed remote-source semantics.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

prepare.basis: Built pinned official OpenJPEG v2.5.3 and executed genuine streaming read/skip/seek callbacks on a 1024×1024 grayscale codestream with 256×256 tiles, RPCL progression and three quality layers. Full decoded pixels equal the generated original. The selected 256×256 area exactly matches both independent full-image crop and separate CLI decode; reduced-resolution and first-layer outputs also match their independently requested references. On the textured fixture, first-layer pixels genuinely differ from full-quality pixels. Actual unique callback reads fall from 505948 to 46513 bytes, a 90.81% reduction, with 15 seek/skip operations. Neither resolution reduction nor quality-layer restriction saves any additional source bytes within that area: both still read 46513. Preserve the earlier highly compressible fixture, whose first layer already contained its lossless output and therefore did not exercise a meaningful quality distinction. Truncated headers and out-of-bounds areas reject without output publication; fresh owners reproduce the accepted result, and every codec/stream/file owner closes. Correctness and the predeclared source-byte-work gate pass. This is logical source-callback work, not OS physical reads, network bytes, decode-time speed, energy, or an integrated browser range reader. Production is unchanged.
